decisive_items: vascular signal extending from the periphery into the center of the lesion
low-echo lesion with regular, clear margins confined to the submucosal layer
submucosal mass on the lesser curvature of the stomach
response.rationale: GIST is the most common gastric submucosal tumor; the EUS features (low-echo, clear margins, submucosal) and especially the peripheral-to-central vascular signal strongly favor GIST over leiomyoma, which typically lacks such vascularity and is often smaller.

rejected.why: Leiomyoma is less likely given the large size and prominent vascular signal; these features are more characteristic of GIST.
